title: Emergency contacts, meeting points and household cards
tldr: Keep a small, current contact plan that works without your phone. Include trusted people, meeting points and essential support contacts, while protecting private information.
steps: Ask a trusted person to help relay status if local calls fail. Confirm what information they should collect and share.
Include household members, caregivers, schools where relevant, veterinary support and essential service contacts. Use current local numbers rather than assuming one number works everywhere.
Name a nearby location for an ordinary separation and an outside-area destination for a wider event. Confirm access and acceptance.
Keep a paper card with each person and a protected home copy. Update numbers and care details after a change.
sections: Record name, trusted contact, meeting point and a few essential support details. Avoid putting full identity documents, access codes, firearm storage locations or detailed medical histories on a card that can be lost. Keep sensitive supporting documents separately with controlled access.

Use a simple format: safe or needing help, current location, who is present, planned destination and next check-in. An outside contact can relay a consistent message so several household members do not spend battery repeating long calls. Avoid posting private locations publicly.
without_help: Use the agreed meeting plan and written numbers. If calls fail, short texts may be more practical when service becomes available; neither is guaranteed. Do not enter danger to retrieve a phone or make a call.
household: Provide large print, relevant languages or accessible formats. Children need age-appropriate instructions and an adult helper; a card does not replace supervision.
pack_now: Keep the equipment and written information described above where the responsible person can reach them. Test access in darkness, with a tired household, and while carrying the items you actually need.
next: Call or message your chosen contact during ordinary conditions, confirm their role, and replace one outdated number.
watch: A listed contact may be unavailable. Verify destination and care arrangements in advance and keep alternatives.
review_status: Source-linked editorial review; not independent expert certification
scope: Civilian educational planning. References include U.S. systems; local laws, conditions and services differ.
